items.exampleEn: The school is phasing in computers for every student.
items.exampleZh: 學校正逐步為每位學生配置電腦。

items.exampleEn: It's hard to pin down exactly why sales fell.
items.exampleZh: 很難明確指出銷售下滑的確切原因。

items.exampleEn: Production is low in summer, but the factory ramps it up before the holidays.

items.exampleEn: A storm hit the coast, but most fishing boats rode it out in the harbor.
items.exampleZh: 暴風雨襲擊海岸，但大部分漁船都在港內安然度過。

items.exampleEn: Reporters quickly seized on one careless remark.
items.exampleZh: 記者很快就抓住一句失言大做文章。

items.exampleEn: She sized the stranger up from head to toe.
items.exampleZh: 她把那個陌生人從頭到腳打量了一番。

items.exampleEn: The city has stepped up its efforts to clean the river.
items.exampleZh: 市政府加強了清理河川的行動。

items.sentenceEn: Can you pin a date down for the meeting?
items.sentenceZh: 你能確定會議的日期嗎？

items.audioEn: We're ramping up our online sales this year, so we need two more people to pack orders.
items.audioZh: 我們今年要加強網路銷售，所以需要多兩個人來包裝訂單。
items.questionZh: 公司為什麼要多請兩個人？
options: Because sales in the shop have dropped

items.sentenceEn: She seized on the chance to work abroad.
items.sentenceZh: 她抓住了到國外工作的機會。

items.sentenceEn: A good salesperson can size up a customer in seconds.
items.sentenceZh: 好的店員幾秒鐘就能看出客人是怎樣的人。

items.stemEn: After the thefts, the shop ____ security at night.
items.stemZh: 發生竊案後，那家店加強了夜間的保全。

items.stemEn: The team managed to ____ a long run of bad results.
items.stemZh: 這支球隊安然度過了一長串的低潮。

items.passageEn: When a popular food show praised its coffee last spring, a small chain of coffee shops seized on the attention. It quickly ramped up its marketing and opened three new branches in six months. To keep quality high, the company created a training program for all new staff and phased it in one shop at a time instead of starting it everywhere at once. Not everything went smoothly, and staff at the busy new branches had to step it up. A shortage of coffee beans pushed costs up in the summer, but the company dealt with the problem by raising prices slightly. Most of its customers did not seem to mind.
items.passageZh: 去年春天，一個熱門美食節目稱讚了某家小型連鎖咖啡店的咖啡，這家店立刻抓住了這波關注。它很快加強行銷，六個月內開了三家新分店。為了維持品質，公司為所有新員工設計了訓練計畫，並一家分店一家分店逐步實施，而不是一次在所有分店同時開始。不過，並不是每件事都很順利，忙碌的新分店員工也得加把勁。夏天時咖啡豆短缺，讓成本上升，公司稍微調高價格來處理這個問題。大部分的顧客似乎並不在意。

questions.questionZh: 這家連鎖咖啡店為什麼突然受到關注？
options: 美食節目稱讚它的咖啡
它推出了新的訓練計畫

questions.questionZh: 公司怎麼處理咖啡豆短缺的問題？
options: 改用比較便宜的咖啡豆

items.promptZh: 這項新政策會在三年內逐步實施。
referenceEn: This new policy will be phased in over three years.
The new policy will be phased in over a period of three years.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「逐步實施」（例如 will be phased in 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 will be introduced gradually、will be rolled out step by step 等）
用表示未來的寫法（例如 will be、is going to be 等）
「在三年內」可寫，例如 over three years、within three years 等

items.promptZh: 她走進房間時打量了一下每個人。
referenceEn: She sized up everyone as she walked into the room.
When she walked into the room, she sized everyone up.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「打量」（例如 sized up everyone、sized everyone up 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 looked everyone over、looked carefully at everyone 等）
時態用過去式（例如 sized up、walked 等）
「走進房間時」可寫，例如 as she walked into the room 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：size up 的 glossZh 第一義是「打量」，但例句「花了一週 sizing the team up」示範的是第二義「評估」，未示範第一義；建議改成當面打量的情境（如 She sized up the stranger at the door.），或把 glossZh 順序改為「評估；打量」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：例句改為 "She sized the stranger up from head to toe."（中譯「她把那個陌生人從頭到腳打量了一番。」），示範第一義「打量」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：「記者很快就抓住了演講裡的每一個字」中文不通順，且沒傳達 seize on 在此「抓住（話柄）大做文章」的意思；建議如「記者很快就抓住演講中的每一句話大做文章」，或換成抓住機會的例句以對應 glossZh。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：例句改為 "Reporters quickly seized on one careless remark."，中譯「記者很快就抓住一句失言大做文章。」
